meta.title: Voice of the Kami
meta.description: She knows the ways of heaven and earth and hears the will of the kami.

units.rawText: At the Oasis' lounge.
units.displayText: At the Oasis' lounge.

spans.text: At the Oasis' lounge.

units.rawText: Ah! Finally finished your script?
units.displayText: Ah! Finally finished your script?

spans.text: Ah! Finally finished your script?

units.rawText: Oh please, efficient scriptwriters only need a single all-nighter for that, unlike SOME people who can only think up 27 different ways to grill fish in a night.
units.displayText: Oh please, efficient scriptwriters only need a single all-nighter for that, unlike SOME people who can only think up 27 different ways to grill fish in a night.

spans.text: Oh please, efficient scriptwriters only need a single all-nighter for that, unlike SOME people who can only think up 27 different ways to grill fish in a night.

units.rawText: Looks like you're pretty happy with your new work. Hope you don't suffer a mental breakdown because of poor reviews from your readers.
units.displayText: Looks like you're pretty happy with your new work. Hope you don't suffer a mental breakdown because of poor reviews from your readers.

spans.text: Looks like you're pretty happy with your new work. Hope you don't suffer a mental breakdown because of poor reviews from your readers.

units.rawText: I had Kimie's help, after all. Besides, the comments from my readers are what drive me to improve. You'll soon see me on the yearly bestsellers list.
units.displayText: I had Kimie's help, after all. Besides, the comments from my readers are what drive me to improve. You'll soon see me on the yearly bestsellers list.

spans.text: I had Kimie's help, after all. Besides, the comments from my readers are what drive me to improve. You'll soon see me on the yearly bestsellers list.

units.rawText: Wow, someone's feeling confident. I'm going to feel second-hand embarrassment for you if you don't make the cut.
units.displayText: Wow, someone's feeling confident. I'm going to feel second-hand embarrassment for you if you don't make the cut.

spans.text: Wow, someone's feeling confident. I'm going to feel second-hand embarrassment for you if you don't make the cut.

units.rawText: Then I'll thank you in advance for worrying for me, Zangyin-sama.
units.displayText: Then I'll thank you in advance for worrying for me, Zangyin-sama.

spans.text: Then I'll thank you in advance for worrying for me, Zangyin-sama.

units.rawText: You copy how Kimie speaks, but you haven't a shred of her politeness or humility. You should be studying the essence, not the form, Nora-sama.
units.displayText: You copy how Kimie speaks, but you haven't a shred of her politeness or humility. You should be studying the essence, not the form, Nora-sama.

spans.text: You copy how Kimie speaks, but you haven't a shred of her politeness or humility. You should be studying the essence, not the form, Nora-sama.

units.rawText: (Coughs) Okay, that's enough banter for now. Where's Kimie?
units.displayText: (Coughs) Okay, that's enough banter for now. Where's Kimie?

spans.text: (Coughs) Okay, that's enough banter for now. Where's Kimie?

units.rawText: We parted ways in a hurry yesterday and I haven't had time to thank her properly.
units.displayText: We parted ways in a hurry yesterday and I haven't had time to thank her properly.

spans.text: We parted ways in a hurry yesterday and I haven't had time to thank her properly.

units.rawText: Oh, I saw her this morning. She looked kind of worried. I guess she went back to the shrine to prepare for Akimatsuri.
units.displayText: Oh, I saw her this morning. She looked kind of worried. I guess she went back to the shrine to prepare for Akimatsuri.

spans.text: Oh, I saw her this morning. She looked kind of worried. I guess she went back to the shrine to prepare for Akimatsuri.

units.rawText: So she went back to the shrine in the end...
units.displayText: So she went back to the shrine in the end...

spans.text: So she went back to the shrine in the end...

units.rawText: Well, Kimie IS a miko, and she has her job to do.
units.displayText: Well, Kimie IS a miko, and she has her job to do.

spans.text: Well, Kimie IS a miko, and she has her job to do.

units.rawText: Our great miko-sama isn't the sort who delays things to the end and stays up all night to finish.
units.displayText: Our great miko-sama isn't the sort who delays things to the end and stays up all night to finish.

spans.text: Our great miko-sama isn't the sort who delays things to the end and stays up all night to finish.

units.rawText: Huh? Is Kimie the only one at the shrine?
units.displayText: Huh? Is Kimie the only one at the shrine?

spans.text: Huh? Is Kimie the only one at the shrine?

units.rawText: Um... Yeah. I asked Kimie if she needed help, but she replied...
units.displayText: Um... Yeah. I asked Kimie if she needed help, but she replied...

spans.text: Um... Yeah. I asked Kimie if she needed help, but she replied...

units.rawText: It seems you all have your own work that needs to be done. There is no need to worry about me.
units.displayText: It seems you all have your own work that needs to be done. There is no need to worry about me.

spans.text: It seems you all have your own work that needs to be done. There is no need to worry about me.

units.rawText: Allow this Kimie to finish the rest. Everyone in the Oasis has graciously accepted this Kimie and this Kimie would like to prepare an Akimatsuri that is uniquely the Oasis'.
units.displayText: Allow this Kimie to finish the rest. Everyone in the Oasis has graciously accepted this Kimie and this Kimie would like to prepare an Akimatsuri that is uniquely the Oasis'.

spans.text: Allow this Kimie to finish the rest. Everyone in the Oasis has graciously accepted this Kimie and this Kimie would like to prepare an Akimatsuri that is uniquely the Oasis'.

units.rawText: I am sure you will understand the feeling, Zangyin-sama.
units.displayText: I am sure you will understand the feeling, Zangyin-sama.

spans.text: I am sure you will understand the feeling, Zangyin-sama.

units.rawText: Um... For some reason it felt like she was pushing herself too hard.
units.displayText: Um... For some reason it felt like she was pushing herself too hard.

spans.text: Um... For some reason it felt like she was pushing herself too hard.

units.rawText: I want to help Kimie, but I don't want to get in her way either... (sigh)
units.displayText: I want to help Kimie, but I don't want to get in her way either... (sigh)

spans.text: I want to help Kimie, but I don't want to get in her way either... (sigh)

units.rawText: How would you be getting in her way? Kimie's probably thinking about everyone right now.
units.displayText: How would you be getting in her way? Kimie's probably thinking about everyone right now.

spans.text: How would you be getting in her way? Kimie's probably thinking about everyone right now.

units.rawText: <size=40>Professor?!</size>
units.displayText: Professor?!

spans.text: Professor?!

units.rawText: Ah, I don't think I've seen an Oasis Akimatsuri yet. Maybe I should go over and see what it's all about.
units.displayText: Ah, I don't think I've seen an Oasis Akimatsuri yet. Maybe I should go over and see what it's all about.

spans.text: Ah, I don't think I've seen an Oasis Akimatsuri yet. Maybe I should go over and see what it's all about.

units.rawText: There might be so much work that you'll be forced to return to the Ops Room in defeat.
units.displayText: There might be so much work that you'll be forced to return to the Ops Room in defeat.

spans.text: There might be so much work that you'll be forced to return to the Ops Room in defeat.

units.rawText: Hehe, does that matter? I've been sitting on my butt for too long; it's about time I moved these bones.
units.displayText: Hehe, does that matter? I've been sitting on my butt for too long; it's about time I moved these bones.

spans.text: Hehe, does that matter? I've been sitting on my butt for too long; it's about time I moved these bones.

units.rawText: Surely the kami won't blame us if we've broken a taboo, right?
units.displayText: Surely the kami won't blame us if we've broken a taboo, right?

spans.text: Surely the kami won't blame us if we've broken a taboo, right?

units.rawText: If we offer our worship with sincere hearts, why would the gods blame a properly pious person?
units.displayText: If we offer our worship with sincere hearts, why would the gods blame a properly pious person?

spans.text: If we offer our worship with sincere hearts, why would the gods blame a properly pious person?

units.rawText: This way, nobody should have any more doubts, right?
units.displayText: This way, nobody should have any more doubts, right?

spans.text: This way, nobody should have any more doubts, right?

units.rawText: You really are sneaky, Professor; you came to ask us about this even though you already had an answer in your heart.
units.displayText: You really are sneaky, Professor; you came to ask us about this even though you already had an answer in your heart.

spans.text: You really are sneaky, Professor; you came to ask us about this even though you already had an answer in your heart.

units.rawText: How could we possibly sit back and ignore a friend in trouble?
units.displayText: How could we possibly sit back and ignore a friend in trouble?

spans.text: How could we possibly sit back and ignore a friend in trouble?

units.rawText: Let's bring everyone else along. Looks like autumn in the Oasis is going to get more lively.
units.displayText: Let's bring everyone else along. Looks like autumn in the Oasis is going to get more lively.

spans.text: Let's bring everyone else along. Looks like autumn in the Oasis is going to get more lively.

units.rawText: A crow swoops overhead and comes to rest on the shrine's torii arch.
units.displayText: A crow swoops overhead and comes to rest on the shrine's torii arch.

spans.text: A crow swoops overhead and comes to rest on the shrine's torii arch.

units.rawText: Kimie sweeps the dense carpet of leaves into a pile. Then she suddenly seems to recall something and a smile appears on her face.
units.displayText: Kimie sweeps the dense carpet of leaves into a pile. Then she suddenly seems to recall something and a smile appears on her face.

spans.text: Kimie sweeps the dense carpet of leaves into a pile. Then she suddenly seems to recall something and a smile appears on her face.

units.rawText: I wonder how Nora-sama's new book is going? Surely she will have finished it once Akimatsuri is over.
units.displayText: I wonder how Nora-sama's new book is going? Surely she will have finished it once Akimatsuri is over.

spans.text: I wonder how Nora-sama's new book is going? Surely she will have finished it once Akimatsuri is over.

units.rawText: Perhaps it would be a good time to bring some snacks over then, to see if I might be graced with a reading of Nora-sama's great work. But what should I bring?
units.displayText: Perhaps it would be a good time to bring some snacks over then, to see if I might be graced with a reading of Nora-sama's great work. But what should I bring?

spans.text: Perhaps it would be a good time to bring some snacks over then, to see if I might be graced with a reading of Nora-sama's great work. But what should I bring?

units.rawText: Roasted sweet potatoes might be good. Kaede-sama always made bonfires with the fallen leaves during autumn.
units.displayText: Roasted sweet potatoes might be good. Kaede-sama always made bonfires with the fallen leaves during autumn.

spans.text: Roasted sweet potatoes might be good. Kaede-sama always made bonfires with the fallen leaves during autumn.

units.rawText: The potatoes would be buried in the leaves, and soon their fragrance would fill the air.
units.displayText: The potatoes would be buried in the leaves, and soon their fragrance would fill the air.

spans.text: The potatoes would be buried in the leaves, and soon their fragrance would fill the air.

units.rawText: The smell remains with this Kimie to this day. Ah! This is not the time for this Kimie to be thinking about this...
units.displayText: The smell remains with this Kimie to this day. Ah! This is not the time for this Kimie to be thinking about this...

spans.text: The smell remains with this Kimie to this day. Ah! This is not the time for this Kimie to be thinking about this...

units.rawText: I need to clean the shrine grounds and hang up the decorations... (Sigh) Everything's gotten dusty after just a few days away...
units.displayText: I need to clean the shrine grounds and hang up the decorations... (Sigh) Everything's gotten dusty after just a few days away...

spans.text: I need to clean the shrine grounds and hang up the decorations... (Sigh) Everything's gotten dusty after just a few days away...

units.rawText: The offerings are not laid out and the kamiki has gone unwatered... It will be hard to finish all this before sunset today.
units.displayText: The offerings are not laid out and the kamiki has gone unwatered... It will be hard to finish all this before sunset today.

spans.text: The offerings are not laid out and the kamiki has gone unwatered... It will be hard to finish all this before sunset today.

units.rawText: I'll just have to do my best.
units.displayText: I'll just have to do my best.

spans.text: I'll just have to do my best.

units.rawText: After thinking for a moment, Kimie turns and begins sweeping the long path in front of the shrine.
units.displayText: After thinking for a moment, Kimie turns and begins sweeping the long path in front of the shrine.

spans.text: After thinking for a moment, Kimie turns and begins sweeping the long path in front of the shrine.

units.rawText: Then, a broom suddenly swoops over and instantly cleans up the place she was about to work on.
units.displayText: Then, a broom suddenly swoops over and instantly cleans up the place she was about to work on.

spans.text: Then, a broom suddenly swoops over and instantly cleans up the place she was about to work on.

units.rawText: As she looks down the path, she sees a familiar face.
units.displayText: As she looks down the path, she sees a familiar face.

spans.text: As she looks down the path, she sees a familiar face.

units.rawText: Kimie, I'm here.
units.displayText: Kimie, I'm here.

spans.text: Kimie, I'm here.

units.rawText: Professor?
units.displayText: Professor?

spans.text: Professor?

units.rawText: Kimie freezes up as friendly faces appear one after another.
units.displayText: Kimie freezes up as friendly faces appear one after another.

spans.text: Kimie freezes up as friendly faces appear one after another.

units.rawText: Sorry, we came in the end. Hope we're not causing you trouble.
units.displayText: Sorry, we came in the end. Hope we're not causing you trouble.

spans.text: Sorry, we came in the end. Hope we're not causing you trouble.

units.rawText: Why didn't you tell us you were preparing for something as fun as Akimatsuri? I thought we were friends.
units.displayText: Why didn't you tell us you were preparing for something as fun as Akimatsuri? I thought we were friends.

spans.text: Why didn't you tell us you were preparing for something as fun as Akimatsuri? I thought we were friends.

units.rawText: (Yawn) I got up extra early today.
units.displayText: (Yawn) I got up extra early today.

spans.text: (Yawn) I got up extra early today.

units.rawText: I'll leave livestreaming the event aside for now and help Kimie tidy up the shrine.
units.displayText: I'll leave livestreaming the event aside for now and help Kimie tidy up the shrine.

spans.text: I'll leave livestreaming the event aside for now and help Kimie tidy up the shrine.

units.rawText: Helix will help, too!
units.displayText: Helix will help, too!

spans.text: Helix will help, too!

units.rawText: Choco already prepared snacks! Lunch is not going to disappoint.
units.displayText: Choco already prepared snacks! Lunch is not going to disappoint.

spans.text: Choco already prepared snacks! Lunch is not going to disappoint.

units.rawText: Sorry to bother you, Kimie. I just wanted to get a couple of helpers, but everyone insisted on coming when they heard you were preparing for Akimatsuri.
units.displayText: Sorry to bother you, Kimie. I just wanted to get a couple of helpers, but everyone insisted on coming when they heard you were preparing for Akimatsuri.

spans.text: Sorry to bother you, Kimie. I just wanted to get a couple of helpers, but everyone insisted on coming when they heard you were preparing for Akimatsuri.

units.rawText: You really are very popular.
units.displayText: You really are very popular.

spans.text: You really are very popular.

units.rawText: Kimie feels a warmth growing in her heart.
units.displayText: Kimie feels a warmth growing in her heart.

spans.text: Kimie feels a warmth growing in her heart.

units.rawText: Everyone...
units.displayText: Everyone...

spans.text: Everyone...

units.rawText: There, there, now isn't the time to be moved to tears.
units.displayText: There, there, now isn't the time to be moved to tears.

spans.text: There, there, now isn't the time to be moved to tears.

units.rawText: Where should we begin with the Akimatsuri preparations? I'm alright doing some cleaning work.
units.displayText: Where should we begin with the Akimatsuri preparations? I'm alright doing some cleaning work.

spans.text: Where should we begin with the Akimatsuri preparations? I'm alright doing some cleaning work.

units.rawText: The Engineering Department can help fix a few of the damaged parts of the shrine.
units.displayText: The Engineering Department can help fix a few of the damaged parts of the shrine.

spans.text: The Engineering Department can help fix a few of the damaged parts of the shrine.

units.rawText: I can help clear away the fallen leaves.
units.displayText: I can help clear away the fallen leaves.

spans.text: I can help clear away the fallen leaves.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: Don't stand on ceremony; feel free to order us around.
units.displayText: Don't stand on ceremony; feel free to order us around.

spans.text: Don't stand on ceremony; feel free to order us around.

units.rawText: Alright, then I'll be counting on you all.
units.displayText: Alright, then I'll be counting on you all.

spans.text: Alright, then I'll be counting on you all.

units.rawText: Zangyin-sama and Nora-sama are more familiar with shrines, so I'll have to trouble you to help clean the shrine's ornaments.
units.displayText: Zangyin-sama and Nora-sama are more familiar with shrines, so I'll have to trouble you to help clean the shrine's ornaments.

spans.text: Zangyin-sama and Nora-sama are more familiar with shrines, so I'll have to trouble you to help clean the shrine's ornaments.

units.rawText: We'll have it done in no time~
units.displayText: We'll have it done in no time~

spans.text: We'll have it done in no time~

units.rawText: Some of the roof tiles are a little loose, and they leak a little during rainy days. I hope Croque-sama and Octogen-sama can help with that.
units.displayText: Some of the roof tiles are a little loose, and they leak a little during rainy days. I hope Croque-sama and Octogen-sama can help with that.

spans.text: Some of the roof tiles are a little loose, and they leak a little during rainy days. I hope Croque-sama and Octogen-sama can help with that.

units.rawText: Roger that!
units.displayText: Roger that!

spans.text: Roger that!

units.rawText: What about me?
units.displayText: What about me?

spans.text: What about me?

units.rawText: There is something I need you to help me with, Helix-sama.
units.displayText: There is something I need you to help me with, Helix-sama.

spans.text: There is something I need you to help me with, Helix-sama.

units.rawText: Helix's eyes gleam with excitement.
units.displayText: Helix's eyes gleam with excitement.

spans.text: Helix's eyes gleam with excitement.

units.rawText: Yup, yup! Helix will get it done for sure!
units.displayText: Yup, yup! Helix will get it done for sure!

spans.text: Yup, yup! Helix will get it done for sure!

units.rawText: Hmm, this task will be...
units.displayText: Hmm, this task will be...

spans.text: Hmm, this task will be...

units.rawText: Kimie whispers something into Helix's ear. Helix nods and runs off happily.
units.displayText: Kimie whispers something into Helix's ear. Helix nods and runs off happily.

spans.text: Kimie whispers something into Helix's ear. Helix nods and runs off happily.

units.rawText: Wow... I can see the sky through this, Croque! The tiles here are really badly damaged.
units.displayText: Wow... I can see the sky through this, Croque! The tiles here are really badly damaged.

spans.text: Wow... I can see the sky through this, Croque! The tiles here are really badly damaged.

units.rawText: Got it! Fortunately, we didn't use the Professor's suggestions of going with a thatched roof...
units.displayText: Got it! Fortunately, we didn't use the Professor's suggestions of going with a thatched roof...

spans.text: Got it! Fortunately, we didn't use the Professor's suggestions of going with a thatched roof...

units.rawText: Yeah, otherwise we'd have to start by planting a tree. Haha...
units.displayText: Yeah, otherwise we'd have to start by planting a tree. Haha...

spans.text: Yeah, otherwise we'd have to start by planting a tree. Haha...

units.rawText: You need to wash these offerings clean, Kuro.
units.displayText: You need to wash these offerings clean, Kuro.

spans.text: You need to wash these offerings clean, Kuro.

units.rawText: Yes, yes, I got it.
units.displayText: Yes, yes, I got it.

spans.text: Yes, yes, I got it.

units.rawText: No, every time I see you glaring at them, I get the feeling the offerings will disappear the next minute.
units.displayText: No, every time I see you glaring at them, I get the feeling the offerings will disappear the next minute.

spans.text: No, every time I see you glaring at them, I get the feeling the offerings will disappear the next minute.

units.rawText: Aw come on, have some faith in me.
units.displayText: Aw come on, have some faith in me.

spans.text: Aw come on, have some faith in me.

units.rawText: I'll let the Professor handle this. Professor!
units.displayText: I'll let the Professor handle this. Professor!

spans.text: I'll let the Professor handle this. Professor!

units.rawText: <size=40>HEY!</size>
units.displayText: HEY!

spans.text: HEY!

units.rawText: The formerly quiet shrine is now a hotbed of activity.
units.displayText: The formerly quiet shrine is now a hotbed of activity.

spans.text: The formerly quiet shrine is now a hotbed of activity.

units.rawText: After a day's work, the preparations for Akimatsuri are finally complete.
units.displayText: After a day's work, the preparations for Akimatsuri are finally complete.

spans.text: After a day's work, the preparations for Akimatsuri are finally complete.

units.rawText: And we're done!
units.displayText: And we're done!

spans.text: And we're done!

units.rawText: Professor.
units.displayText: Professor.

spans.text: Professor.

units.rawText: I put the offering I'm holding in its designated location, then turn to look at Kimie. She is dressed in her ceremonial vestments and waiting quietly for me.
units.displayText: I put the offering I'm holding in its designated location, then turn to look at Kimie. She is dressed in her ceremonial vestments and waiting quietly for me.

spans.text: I put the offering I'm holding in its designated location, then turn to look at Kimie. She is dressed in her ceremonial vestments and waiting quietly for me.

units.rawText: This Kimie is ready to perform the kagura for Akimatsuri. I hope you will enjoy it.
units.displayText: This Kimie is ready to perform the kagura for Akimatsuri. I hope you will enjoy it.

spans.text: This Kimie is ready to perform the kagura for Akimatsuri. I hope you will enjoy it.

units.rawText: This is the first time I've seen you dance the kagura. I'm looking forward to it.
units.displayText: This is the first time I've seen you dance the kagura. I'm looking forward to it.

spans.text: This is the first time I've seen you dance the kagura. I'm looking forward to it.

units.rawText: Kimie... This Kimie will do her best.
units.displayText: Kimie... This Kimie will do her best.

spans.text: Kimie... This Kimie will do her best.

units.rawText: Mhm.
units.displayText: Mhm.

spans.text: Mhm.

units.rawText: Night has come much earlier ever since autumn came.
units.displayText: Night has come much earlier ever since autumn came.

spans.text: Night has come much earlier ever since autumn came.

units.rawText: Kimie looks especially holy tonight, dancing under the moonlight and holding her kagura-suzu while limned in silver radiance.
units.displayText: Kimie looks especially holy tonight, dancing under the moonlight and holding her kagura-suzu while limned in silver radiance.

spans.text: Kimie looks especially holy tonight, dancing under the moonlight and holding her kagura-suzu while limned in silver radiance.

units.rawText: She begins the steps of her dance as she shakes her kagura-suzu, in time with the music.
units.displayText: She begins the steps of her dance as she shakes her kagura-suzu, in time with the music.

spans.text: She begins the steps of her dance as she shakes her kagura-suzu, in time with the music.

units.rawText: Everything seems like the Akimatsuri from that year. She is surrounded by countless people, watching her with their ardent gazes.
units.displayText: Everything seems like the Akimatsuri from that year. She is surrounded by countless people, watching her with their ardent gazes.

spans.text: Everything seems like the Akimatsuri from that year. She is surrounded by countless people, watching her with their ardent gazes.

units.rawText: ...Well, that's no good. The gods require sincere devotion. What do Dolls know of faith? They don't even have hearts.
units.displayText: ...Well, that's no good. The gods require sincere devotion. What do Dolls know of faith? They don't even have hearts.

spans.text: ...Well, that's no good. The gods require sincere devotion. What do Dolls know of faith? They don't even have hearts.

units.rawText: That's right! The very existence of a Doll like this is blasphemy!
units.displayText: That's right! The very existence of a Doll like this is blasphemy!

spans.text: That's right! The very existence of a Doll like this is blasphemy!

units.rawText: The memories of the past wash over her like a flood, and for a moment Kimie cannot breathe.
units.displayText: The memories of the past wash over her like a flood, and for a moment Kimie cannot breathe.

spans.text: The memories of the past wash over her like a flood, and for a moment Kimie cannot breathe.

units.rawText: The gentle music starts to grate on the ear, and her steps grow unsteady, as though she were treading on cotton.
units.displayText: The gentle music starts to grate on the ear, and her steps grow unsteady, as though she were treading on cotton.

spans.text: The gentle music starts to grate on the ear, and her steps grow unsteady, as though she were treading on cotton.

units.rawText: (A blasphemy against the kami... No, it's not like that...)
units.displayText: A blasphemy against the kami... No, it's not like that...

spans.text: A blasphemy against the kami... No, it's not like that...

units.rawText: (Can I still keep dancing? I...)
units.displayText: Can I still keep dancing? I...

spans.text: Can I still keep dancing? I...

units.rawText: Kimie!
units.displayText: Kimie!

spans.text: Kimie!

units.rawText: A gentle voice reaches her ears and she sees one concerned face after another.
units.displayText: A gentle voice reaches her ears and she sees one concerned face after another.

spans.text: A gentle voice reaches her ears and she sees one concerned face after another.

units.rawText: Professor... Everyone...
units.displayText: Professor... Everyone...

spans.text: Professor... Everyone...

units.rawText: Focus. Ignore that idle gossip. The kami themselves are watching your dance.
units.displayText: Focus. Ignore that idle gossip. The kami themselves are watching your dance.

spans.text: Focus. Ignore that idle gossip. The kami themselves are watching your dance.

units.rawText: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.
units.displayText: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.

spans.text: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.

units.rawText: At this rate... the kami will surely see...
units.displayText: At this rate... the kami will surely see...

spans.text: At this rate... the kami will surely see...

units.rawText: Will the kami... see this...
units.displayText: Will the kami... see this...

spans.text: Will the kami... see this...

units.displayText: Professor...

units.displayText: Thank you for your hard work, Kimie. Your kagura was lovely.

spans.text: Thank you for your hard work, Kimie. Your kagura was lovely.

units.rawText: I... faltered a little just now, while I was dancing. I recalled some things from the past.
units.displayText: I... faltered a little just now, while I was dancing. I recalled some things from the past.

spans.text: I... faltered a little just now, while I was dancing. I recalled some things from the past.

units.rawText: But after hearing your encouragement, this Kimie could make up her mind.

spans.text: Things from the past, hm...

units.rawText: Yes. When this Kimie travelled in the past, I once danced for the Akimatsuri.
units.displayText: Yes. When this Kimie travelled in the past, I once danced for the Akimatsuri.

spans.text: Yes. When this Kimie travelled in the past, I once danced for the Akimatsuri.

units.rawText: At that time, this Kimie was recognized as a priestess Doll. Many local residents felt that a Doll could not be pious and could not convey their feelings to the kami.
units.displayText: At that time, this Kimie was recognized as a priestess Doll. Many local residents felt that a Doll could not be pious and could not convey their feelings to the kami.

spans.text: And that was when you returned to the shrine and traveled no more?

units.rawText: Yes. This Kimie did not intend to shake the faith of others. Perhaps serving the kami in the shrine was the best answer.
units.displayText: Yes. This Kimie did not intend to shake the faith of others. Perhaps serving the kami in the shrine was the best answer.

spans.text: Yes. This Kimie did not intend to shake the faith of others. Perhaps serving the kami in the shrine was the best answer.

units.rawText: Kaede-sama... said so, too.
units.displayText: Kaede-sama... said so, too.

spans.text: Kaede-sama... said so, too.

units.rawText: The soul of a Doll executing their base layer commands is far purer than any human being's.
units.displayText: The soul of a Doll executing their base layer commands is far purer than any human being's.

spans.text: The soul of a Doll executing their base layer commands is far purer than any human being's.

units.rawText: If their faith was shaken, then it just means they were never that faithful in the first place. Kaede-sama must have seen the true face of the world many times over; how could she not have known that?

units.displayText: Ah... But...

spans.text: Ah... But...

units.rawText: Nobody was willing to inherit the tradition of being a shrine maiden, but your arrival gave her aged self so much hope.
units.displayText: Nobody was willing to inherit the tradition of being a shrine maiden, but your arrival gave her aged self so much hope.

spans.text: Nobody was willing to inherit the tradition of being a shrine maiden, but your arrival gave her aged self so much hope.

units.displayText: Kaede-sama...
